== Overview ==

'''Life Support''' is the compulsory core internal module that maintains a breathable atmosphere while it is powered and functioning. Its class is fixed by the ship hull, while ratings E through A determine mass, integrity, power draw, purchase price, and the duration of the emergency oxygen carried by the commander's Remlok mask.<ref name="edwiki-life-support">Elite Dangerous Wiki, [https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Life_Support Life Support].</ref>

Emergency oxygen activates when Life Support is switched off, loses power, is disabled, or when the cockpit canopy breaches. The remaining time appears as a countdown on the HUD. Reaching zero is fatal, so the practical value of a higher rating is the extra time available to dock, synthesize oxygen, or restore a disabled module.

== Emergency-oxygen duration ==

The oxygen reserve depends on rating rather than module class.<ref name="edcd-life-support">EDCD Coriolis Data, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EDCD/coriolis-data/9e5273b56426596061e2b02a6ba53e3e4103c9ab/modules/standard/life_support.json Life Support dataset].</ref>

Class changes the module's physical and electrical specifications but not those five time limits. Larger ships therefore use a larger Life Support class without receiving more emergency time from class alone.

== Loss of atmosphere ==

A disabled Life Support module and a breached canopy both start the same emergency-oxygen countdown, but the solutions differ:

* If the canopy is intact, restoring power or repairing and reactivating Life Support can restore normal operation.
* If the canopy has completely breached, repairing Life Support does not seal the open cockpit; the commander must reach a suitable port or continue replenishing oxygen until safe.
* Entering a station's pressurized docking area stops the immediate oxygen drain. Docking and entering the hangar restores the normal reserve.<ref name="edwiki-life-support" />

The [[Auto Field-Maintenance Unit]] can repair a damaged Life Support module. The target module is offline during repair, so the oxygen timer starts while that maintenance is in progress. Confirm the remaining reserve before beginning.

== Emergency synthesis ==

A basic Life Support refill can be synthesized from:<ref name="inara-synthesis">INARA, [https://inara.cz/elite/synthesis/ Synthesis].</ref>

* 2 Iron; and
* 1 Nickel.

The recipe replenishes emergency oxygen without requiring a station. Carrying several refills is inexpensive insurance for exploration or other operations far from inhabited systems, but synthesis does not repair a breached canopy or damaged module.

== Selecting a rating ==

A '''D-rated''' Life Support module is the lightest stock option and provides 7 minutes 30 seconds of emergency oxygen. It is common on jump-range-focused ships where mass matters more than reserve time.

An '''A-rated''' unit provides 25 minutes, making it the safest stock choice for ships expected to operate far from a suitable port or to survive canopy breaches in combat. It uses more power and costs more than lower ratings, but it has the same stock mass as E-, C-, and A-rated modules of the same class.<ref name="edcd-life-support" />

B- and C-rated modules offer intermediate reserve times. B rating also carries the largest mass in each class, while C rating retains the standard mass profile.

== Engineering ==

Life Support accepts three blueprint families and has no Experimental Effects:<ref name="inara-blueprints">INARA, [https://inara.cz/elite/blueprints/#outfittingslot4 Blueprints and upgrades].</ref>

* '''Lightweight''' reduces mass while reducing module integrity.
* '''Reinforced''' increases integrity while adding mass.
* '''Shielded''' increases integrity while increasing passive power draw.

Lightweight Engineering is useful when jump range is the priority. Reinforced and Shielded improve survival in builds where losing Life Support under fire is the larger concern.

== Acquisition ==

Every ship carries a Life Support module in its dedicated Environment Control core slot. Replacement ratings are purchased for credits through Outfitting; no rank, permit, Engineer, or Technology Broker unlock is required. The available class is determined by the ship, and station stock varies.

== Related modules ==

* [[Auto Field-Maintenance Unit]] — can repair damaged Life Support while the oxygen timer is running.
* [[Sensors]] — the other core internal family commonly selected at D rating to reduce ship mass.
* [[Power Plant]] — supplies the power required to keep Life Support and other modules online.
